description: Foldseek fold-assignment summary table and figure for AllF, AllG, AllH
code:
import json, os, pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
OUT=os.getcwd()
df=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT,"foldseek_hits_all.csv"))

# ---------- Provenance table 1: fold assignment summary ----------
summary=[]
for q in ["AllF","AllG","AllH"]:
    for db in ["pdb100","cath50","afdb-swissprot"]:
        s=df[(df['query']==q)&(df['db']==db)]
        nonself=s[~s['target'].astype(str).str.contains("Q47208|P77129|P0AAS5",na=False)]
        best=nonself.sort_values("eval").head(1)
        summary.append(dict(query=q, db=db, n_alignments=len(s),
                            n_signif_E_lt_1e3=int((s['eval']<1e-3).sum()),
                            best_nonself_target=(best['target'].iloc[0][:70] if len(best) else None),
                            best_nonself_eval=(best['eval'].iloc[0] if len(best) else None)))
st=pd.DataFrame(summary)
st.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT,"table1_foldseek_fold_assignment.csv"),index=False)
print(st.to_string(index=False))

# ---------- Figure ----------
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(16.5,5.6))
labels={"AllF":"AllF (Q47208, 555 aa)","AllG":"AllG (P77129, 419 aa)","AllH":"AllH (P0AAS5, 271 aa)"}
for ax,q in zip(axes,["AllF","AllG","AllH"]):
    s=df[(df['query']==q)].copy()
    s=s[~s['target'].astype(str).str.contains("Q47208|P77129|P0AAS5",na=False)]
    s=s.sort_values("eval").drop_duplicates("target").head(10)
    y=np.arange(len(s))[::-1]
    nl=-np.log10(np.clip(s['eval'].values,1e-120,None))
    def short(t):
        t=str(t).replace("-assembly1.cif.gz","").replace("-assembly2.cif.gz","").replace("-F1-model_v6","")
        t=t.replace("AF-","").replace("Crystal structure of a ","").replace("Crystal Structure of a ","")
        return t[:52]
    colors=["#c0392b" if ("carbamoyl" in str(t).lower() or "transcarb" in str(t).lower()) else "#2c6fbb" for t in s['target']]
    ax.barh(y,nl,color=colors)
    ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels([short(t) for t in s['target']],fontsize=7.5)
    ax.axvline(3,color="grey",ls="--",lw=1)
    ax.set_xlabel("-log10(Foldseek E-value)")
    ax.set_title(labels[q],fontsize=11)
axes[0].text(0.98,0.03,"dashed line: E = 1e-3\nno carbamoyltransferase or\ncarbamate-kinase fold in any panel",
             transform=axes[0].transAxes,ha="right",va="bottom",fontsize=8,
             bbox=dict(fc="#fff3cd",ec="#d0b000"))
fig.suptitle("Foldseek structure-based fold assignment of the three OXTCase subunits (PDB100, CATH50, AFDB-SwissProt)",fontsize=12)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
